intended_use: Software benchmarking; analyte and uncertainty metadata for reconstituted human serum (Table A2 non-certified mass fractions).
limitations: Non-certified values only; not for regulatory compliance or certified-property claims. Matrix is serum — do not merge with environmental or calibration-line datasets.

intended_use: Extended row-level metadata (isomers, traceability text) for the same Table A2 consensus values as the slim serum file.
limitations: Same limitations as Table A2 non-certified data; maintain separation from non-serum matrices.

intended_use: Calibration and process-control reference for LC-MS/MS workflows; analyte mapping in methanol matrix.
limitations: Not a field or exposure matrix; not wet-lab PT. Values non-certified; verify current NIST documentation before operational lab use.

intended_use: AFFF / foam-associated PFAS profile; environmental and forensic context (e.g. PFOS-dominant patterns).
limitations: Foam formulation matrix — not drinking water, serum, or generic soil. Non-certified; do not infer site concentrations without matching sampling and prep context.

intended_use: Stack-gas PFAS measurements at a fluoropolymer manufacturer (thermal-oxidizer controls, 2023); industrial source characterization and air-emission ML features.
limitations: Single-facility OTM-50 (Other Test Method) dataset; not EPA-promulgated compliance method, not ambient air, not drinking water, not biosolids. Do not merge with UCMR, NHANES, ICIS-NPDES, or NIST reference rows.

intended_use: Vent-stream PFAS measurements at a fluoropolymer manufacturer (2023); industrial source characterization.
limitations: Single-facility OTM-50 dataset; air-emissions matrix only. Same separation rules as the FW_TO row.

intended_use: Vessel / process PFAS measurements at a fluoropolymer manufacturer (2024); industrial source characterization.
limitations: Single-facility OTM-50 dataset; air-emissions matrix only. Same separation rules as the FW_TO row.

intended_use: PFAS-flagged rows extracted from EPA ICIS-AIR_POLLUTANTS.csv via scripts/filter_icis_air_pfas.py. Two rows (EPA aggregate PERFLUOROCARBONS code 300000288, CAS 308069-13-8); facility linkage and air-program context.
limitations: Program-reporting metadata, not analytical concentrations. The matched CAS is the EPA aggregate Perfluorocarbons (fluorinated GHGs CF4/C2F6/C3F8), NOT a drinking-water-class PFAS analyte; do not conflate with PFOA/PFOS targets. Do not merge with OTM-50, UCMR, NHANES, NPDES DMR, or NIST rows.

intended_use: Facility x analyte rollup of icis_air_pfas_pollutants.csv. Two distinct (pgm_sys_id, pollutant_code, pollutant_desc) tuples for join-key use in the Shiny app.
limitations: Same governance caveats as the row-level file; carries no units or concentrations.

intended_use: EPA ECHO ICIS-NPDES biosolids facility / permit / compliance bulk export (NPDES_BIOSOLIDS_PERMITS, INSPECTIONS, SEV_VIOLATIONS, FORMAL_ACTIONS, INFML_ENF_ACTIONS).
limitations: Program metadata only (permits, inspections, violations, enforcement actions) — NOT nationwide PFAS-in-biosolids concentrations. Analytical PFAS context for this matrix comes from EPA Method 1633(A). Do not merge with UCMR, NHANES, OTM-50, ICIS-AIR, or NIST rows.

intended_use: Per-lane training output of scripts/run_matrix_pipeline.py --lane biosolids_sludge. One row per BIOSOLIDS_FLAG='Y' permit (12449) + 1 EPA Method 1633A metadata anchor row; matrix_governance_note carries per-facility compliance counts (inspections, severe_violations, formal_actions, informal_actions).
limitations: Rows are program metadata + method metadata, not PFAS measurements. Use as the biosolids matrix label space + compliance enrichment, never pooled with other pipeline_lane lanes.

intended_use: Per-analyte log10 envelope AD model for the drinking_water lane (built from UCMR5 detects). Used by scripts/apply_ad_guard.py for hard refusal of out-of-domain predictions.
limitations: Bound to the drinking_water lane only; never use to gate predictions for any other matrix. Rebuild after the lane's training.csv changes.

intended_use: Per-analyte log10 envelope AD model for the serum lane (NHANES + SRM 1957). Used for hard refusal at prediction time.
limitations: Bound to the serum lane only; do not reuse for any other matrix.

intended_use: Categorical-coverage AD model for the biosolids_sludge lane (state / method / matrix coverage). Explicitly refuses concentration-claim rows (value_type='field_measurement') because this lane is governance/enrichment only.
limitations: Different AD semantics from value-based lanes: no numerical envelope, only categorical membership; do not reuse for analytical lanes.

intended_use: Per-analyte AD model for the afff lane (NIST RM 8690). Most analytes have n=1 detects (sparse) and trigger 'sparse_training' warnings; unseen analytes are rejected.
limitations: Reference-material space only; do not gate field foam concentrations with this small envelope.

intended_use: Per-analyte AD model for the methanol_standards lane (NIST RM 8446). Sparse training envelope (n=1 per analyte); used for calibration-space membership checks.
limitations: Calibration-style reference space only; not transferrable to field matrices.

intended_use: Per-analyte AD model for the air_emissions lane (EPA OTM-50 stack measurements). Mixed-unit envelope (ug/m3 and ng/l-per-ppb forms preserved separately); some analytes have only ND or single-value detects which correctly trigger refusal or sparse warnings.
limitations: Bound to OTM-50 air-emissions stack chemistry; not portable to ambient air, drinking water, or biosolids.
